thread:
mia_sales: Heads-up — HelioConnect execs just flagged a P0 from their CTO. During the private POC today they saw intermittent token timeouts and 10-20% throughput drop on long-chat workloads. They're asking for an exec call if we don't have a remediation by EOD. @chen_se can you summarize the test setup? :warning:
chen_se: Running on private deploy (eu-west) with Dedicated pool (4x A100), sequence lengths ~ 4k, continuous batching enabled. Repro: during 30m sustained run throughput fell from 220 rps -> 180 rps. Latency spikes to 600ms on tail. Logs show repeated kv-cache misses and occasional GPU memory peaks. Will paste snippets.
chen_se: log snippet:
```
2026-03-19T14:02:11Z runtime: kvcache miss key=0x7f8b... miss_count=12
2026-03-19T14:02:12Z runtime: enqueue batch size=64 latency=18ms
2026-03-19T14:02:15Z runtime: nvlink error: peer reset detected
```
chen_se: Also saw some encryption handshake retries when we attempted customer KMS integration — not sure if network jitter caused TLS renegotiation.
oliver_runtime: NVLink peer reset looks like a driver/firmware flake — we've seen this on older host images when CUDA+Mellanox drivers mismatch. Possible root cause for intermittent perf drop. I'll check node driver versions.
adam_infra: Which AMI/image? If image is a mix of patched kernels that could trigger the NIC reset. Also worth checking MTU and jumbo frames on Helio side.
chen_se: Image is rwi-2026-02-07-gpu. Customer requested private deployment in their VPC, we provisioned using our private package. We tested with their network team but they use a managed firewall that does TLS proxying.
nina_ciso: Security note — Helio's security team is also asking for confirmation on our KMS flow and if TLS termination is inside their VPC or at our gateway. They want explicit confirmation we never cache unencrypted KV outside the HSM boundary. I can draft answers once I have the exact flow.
kai_support: From support side, we can temporarily flip traffic to Hosted (eu-west) for the POC to prove baseline throughput while infra/eng fix the private node issue. That removes customer-managed network from the equation.
mia_sales: They explicitly want to validate private deployment performance though — but they agreed to a short hosted fallback if we can guarantee parity for the test window. They care about unit cost too; CFO asked about reserved capacity pricing if we need dedicated pools long-term.
oliver_runtime: Quick mitigation plan: (1) patch host drivers to the validated combo (I can push a build and schedule a rolling reboot), (2) disable jumbo frames negotiation to avoid MTU mismatches for now, (3) if NVLink errors persist, fallback to same-model hosted nodes to rule out VPC-networking. I estimate 2-3 hours to run the driver build and smoke test.
chen_se: I'll coordinate with Helio ops for a small maintenance window. Can someone on infra open a private-capacity hotfix ticket and tag oncall? @adam_infra
adam_infra: Opening ticket now and notifying oncall. Ticket: INF-9271. Also starting capacity warm-up in eu-west hosted to stand up a hot fallback cluster.
deploy-bot: Deployment triggered by oliver_runtime: patch-driver-2026-03-19 -> staging -> smoke. Status: queued.
oliver_runtime: Will monitor GPU health + nvlink logs and run our perf harness. If we still see >5% drop we'll collect full perf traces for inference kernel scheduling.
chen_se: Customer also asked about SLA numbers — wants 99.9% availability and p95 latency < 250ms for inference. For private we usually commit based on reserved capacity. Clarifying if they want committed nodes or burstable.
mia_sales: CFO is leaning toward reserved for production, but wants a POC-level discount now. We should keep the offer structured: POC discount for 6 weeks, then reserved contract tiers if they convert. @nina_ciso we need a compliance package summary to move legal along.
nina_ciso: I'll send the SOC2/ISO summary and a short KMS diagram. Also need to confirm audit logging retention and access controls — Helio will require 90-day logs.
kai_support: I'll prepare a runbook for the hosted-fallback test and a checklist for verifying KV cache persistence and encryption.
adam_infra: ETA updates: hosted fallback cluster ready in ~45m, patch build started (oliver) ~15m, coordinated maintenance window requested for 17:00 UTC.
mia_sales: Setting exec call tentatively at 18:00 UTC in case mitigation doesn't finish. I'll update Helio with the plan (hosted fallback offer + timeline).
oliver_runtime: If we can prove hosted parity, we should propose a short performative baseline run on hosted that Helio signs off, then we re-run private with patched drivers. That reduces executive pressure.
chen_se: Agreed. I'll prepare perf run script and provide a short summary doc with numbers (rps, p95, mem usage).
mia_sales: Action items summarized: oliver -> build/patch drivers + monitor (ETA 2-3h), adam -> INF ticket + spin hosted fallback (ETA 45m), chen -> perf script + coordinate maintenance, nina -> security/compliance packet + KMS flow, kai -> hosted runbook. I'll ping again after the 17:00 window. :white_check_mark:
kai_support: ack :thumbsup:
adam_infra: INF-9271 updated with hosted fallback details and oncall @oncall-infra.
oliver_runtime: Patch log (short): driver-11.8.2 -> driver-11.8.5, kernel modules rebuilt. smoke run queued.
mia_sales: Thanks team — I'll keep Helio execs in the loop and push the exec call back a couple hours if we can show progress. Please drop short updates here only (no emails) so I can keep the thread clean.
chen_se: smoke perf results (after hosted fallback): baseline hosted rps=225 p95=180ms, private pre-patch rps=180 p95=420ms, private post-patch rps=222 p95=190ms. Looks good.
mia_sales: Fantastic — I'll schedule the exec 1:1 for 19:00 UTC to present results and next-steps for production (reserved capacity + compliance package). Closing the thread after the exec unless new blockers appear. :tada:
